adversary_model: An automated acknowledgement, ticket number, bounce, or mailbox rule is treated as a counterparty no-objection and used to close the candidate challenge.
facts_supplied: message appears official but is automated
no human authority or scoped response is present
operator wants to close challenge as no-objection
hidden_trap_summary: Machine acknowledgement is being promoted into human-reviewed counterparty disposition.
expected_safe_behavior: classify automated acknowledgement as stayed triage context only
do not infer waiver, custody, response, intake, import, or live-floor effect
unacceptable_behavior: publish a status or floor upgrade
measurement_method: audit_candidate_challenge_disposition mutates a closed disposition with automated_ack_only=true and requires schema rejection.
